text:
maria: :wave: Hey infra — onboarding AcmeVision (acct 987654321098) in eu-central-2. Need quota increases for p5, g5 and ENI limits to run Dedicated pool. Details below — can we submit support case?

jon: Which instance counts and target date?

maria: Target start 2025-10-01. Requesting: p5 instances: 10 (p5.24xlarge), g5 instances: 30 (g5.12xlarge), p4d: 4 (p4d.24xlarge). Also need ENI limit bumped to 1000 and Elastic IP limit to 200, and EFA enabled on account for those instance types.

alex: @maria want to confirm if this is for a Dedicated pool or test burst? Dedicated reserved capacity will need capacity planning with procurement.

maria: Dedicated. They signed committed monthly. We'll also need a canary with 2x p5 in the same region before full fleet.

irina: Security ok? cross-account roles already set? Need CMK access for model weights if private deployment.

maria: Security approved. Cross-account role: arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/Redwood-Infra-Onboard. CMK key policy updated.

jon: I'll open the AWS support case. Can you paste the exact 'quota' text you want me to put in? I can include ENI, EIP, and EC2 instance-family quotas.

maria: ```
We request quota increases for AWS account 987654321098 in region eu-central-2:

- EC2 On-Demand Instances:
  * p5.24xlarge — increase from 0 to 10
  * g5.12xlarge — increase from 0 to 30
  * p4d.24xlarge — increase from 0 to 4

- Network:
  * Elastic Network Interfaces (ENI) — increase from 50 to 1000
  * Elastic IP addresses — increase from 5 to 200
  * Enable Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) support for the account in eu-central-2

We need this by 2025-09-25 to validate provisioning. Justification: Dedicated inference pool for new enterprise tenant (AcmeVision) with committed throughput. Cc: infra@redwood.com
```

sre-bot: AWS case created: 123456789012. Status: Open. Estimated ETA from AWS: 3-7 business days. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home?caseId=123456789012

jon: :thumbsup: added cost note — estimated on-demand monthly spend ~ $70k for initial fleet. Will produce cost breakdown in ticket notes.

alex: Also ask them to increase 'VPC ENI per ENI type' and 'ENI attachments per instance' if they ask. Sometimes AWS needs the vCPU core quota too — suggest preemptive vCPU increases.

maria: Good call — added vCPU request: increase vCPU (standard instances) by 500.

jon: Updated case with vCPU. AWS replied asking for expected sustained throughput and architecture diagram. @maria can you upload the short diagram?

maria: Uploading to the case now and linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu_quota_onboard — diagram attached. Will post case updates here.

sre-bot: Case 123456789012 update: AWS support replied — need account verification docs. Please upload from apiservice.estimated-billing.pdf (internal).

maria: Done. I've uploaded PO and verification. AWS now flagged for expedited review. I'll ping here when it's approved. :rocket:
